# Empty Collection?

![Empty Collection? function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/collection/common/empty-collection.svg)

[Collection functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

True only for a collection with zero entries/elements. A stored zero, False or empty string is still an element. This read-only test never empties the collection.
